meta.name: Stroke volume vs frequency A (valves, 0.5 mm tube, supply)
meta.description: Net per stroke vs frequency and voltage, WITH valves, 0.5 mm ID observation tube. 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 100 Hz; levels 2.5, 1.5, 1, 0.8, 0.6, 0.5, 0.4 V set by the RSD3305P programmable supply (no operator steps; yellow banners only to re-centre the stage). Bursts sized for ~2.5 mm meniscus travel at V0 tanh(1/(4 f tau)) from the 1-2 Nov run (0.8 V values below 0.8 V); 2 bursts per cell, 10 s rests; passes down/up. POWER ON (PPK2 in line; below 0.8 V the PPK2 is unverified, cross-check with supply/supply.csv). Prime BEFORE aligning the tube: no priming in this run. Tick Record video; type the Pump ID.
meta.supply_readback_cal: supply mA = 0.980 x I_PPK2 - 3.2 mA (1-2 Nov), whole mA, reads 0 at 0.3 V
